subject: RunLevelData is not available when I set remove50missing=TRUE in processData

messages.author: 0c5ec2c4dfce1ca1
messages.subject: RunLevelData is not available when I set remove50missing=TRUE in processData
parts:
Hello,

I am using MSstats to process a large DDA dataset (some conditions have only one biological replicate that I will do a separate analysis on just to look for presence/absence of proteins, but for most of the dataset there are four conditions at 8 different times - not repeated measures with 3-4 bioReps for most samples and some samples with technical reps) that was first processed by maxQuant. 

 I ran dataProcess() using the following and it seemingly worked great (output message attached in 'dataProcess.output'):

quant.maxquant <- dataProcess(input.maxquant logTrans = 2,
normalization='equalizeMedians',
summaryMethod="TMP",
cutoffCensored="minFeature", censoredInt="NA",
MBimpute=TRUE,
maxQuantileforCensored=0.999)

However, I had a lot of missing data and so was worried about the imputation:
dim(quant.maxquant$RunlevelData) #68928
sum(quant.maxquant$RunlevelData$more50missing==TRUE) # 59903
sum(quant.maxquant$RunlevelData$more50missing==FALSE) # 9025

and so I decided to run processData again with remove50missing=TRUE, but when I did, I did not get any RunLevelData in the output.

Here is what I ended up running:
quant.maxquant.rm50 <- dataProcess(input.maxquant, logTrans = 2,
normalization='equalizeMedians',
summaryMethod="TMP",
cutoffCensored="minFeature", censoredInt="NA",
MBimpute=TRUE,
maxQuantileforCensored=0.999,remove50missing=TRUE)

The standard output of dataProcess() is attached as a text file here in 'dataProcess.rm50.output'.  

head(quant.maxquant.rm50$RunlevelData)
Null

Any help would be much appreciated!

Thanks,
Nadia

messages.author: 6597c45f2a31b5d0
messages.subject: Re: RunLevelData is not available when I set remove50missing=TRUE in processData
parts:
Hi,

Apologies for the delay.  A couple follow ups:
  1. Are you able to upgrade to the latest version of R (R4.4) and MSstats (4.12.0)?  Your version looks to be outdated and I'm not sure if we can properly debug an old version of the package.
  2. What's your understanding of how the "remove50Missing" parameter works?  According to our documentation, "remove50Missing = TRUE removes the proteins where every run has at least 50% missing values for each peptide", so very rarely should you see it doing anything to your dataset.
Thanks,
Tony
